extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath process execution view for a Benefit Claims Processing workflow, with a BPMN-style process diagram on top and execution details below. The completed process includes document extraction, fraud research agents, eligibility determination, case worker review, and approval/rejection email paths. The bottom pane has the Global variables tab selected and highlighted, showing extracted and computed values such as the application PDF, address, household size, monthly income, and applicant name.
extraction.step_instructions: Informational screenshot — no user action required. It shows the completed execution trail and the Global variables table, where the user can verify that values such as Address, HouseholdSize, MonthlyIncome, and Name were populated correctly.
